summary: Kaniksu NF lookout in Bonner County: a 1936 steel tower, a 1959 Aermotor tower, both removed. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Tower and cabin removed; the removal date is not given. No source describes what remains.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources give 45 feet (1936 Newport Miner report), 40 feet (1959 Newport Hill listings) and 80 feet (the Binarch Mountain history's 1934 Aermotor, said to have been moved to Newport Hill in 1959). None of the sources reconcile these, so the story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.
The 1936 report describes a tower under construction; the 1959 listings give a 40-foot tower built that year. No source read says whether the 1959 tower replaced the 1936 one.

sources.title: Newport Hill
sources.publisher: Forest Lookouts (Ron Kemnow), quoting the Newport Miner, Aug 20 1936

notes_for_editor: Heights disagree across four sources (40, 45, 80 ft); the record's height_m 13.7 equals the 45-foot 1936 figure, not the 1959 40-foot tower. Not proposed as a correction because height is not a correction field; a human should decide which structure the record describes. Record location 48.23247,-116.98888 was not checked against Oldtown; firelookout.com gives only '4 miles NNE of Oldtown'. No staffing history found. The removal date is unknown. No source describes the site today.
